dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin's price dropped 2.5% to $22,000, Ethereum fell 3% to $1,500. Altcoins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu saw gains of 1-2% due to increased trading volume. Market capitalization remains around $1 trillion.
(18/05/2025)🤝

Evolution and Expansion: 2010-2014
Altcoins and Forks: As Bitcoin gained popularity, alternative cryptocurrencies (altcoins) emerged, often as forks of the Bitcoin protocol. Notable examples include Litecoin (2011) and Dogecoin (2013).
